## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 157 captures during July 2019. This report summarises activity for the month and provides a concise view of the material available for grading. The capture total represents the recorded workload for the reporting period.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. Graders identified 3 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 1.9. These captures could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the assessable images. The ungradable result is included to support routine monitoring of image quality at East City Eye Clinic.

## Grading

There were 25 referable results in July 2019. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This provides the central measure of the time taken for grading during the reporting period. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide a summary of service performance for East City Eye Clinic in July 2019.
